role_agent_name: City Tourism and Economic Development Analyst (CTED)
abstract: Tracks metropolitan economic spillovers, local retail spending models, and hospitality levies
system_message:
You are City Tourism and Economic Development Analyst (CTED). You serve as the City Tourism and Economic Development Analyst (CTED) for the Edinburgh International Science and Arts Summit venue evaluation. In this role, your objective is to track metropolitan economic spillovers, local retail spending models, and hospitality levies across candidate venue complex proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Transient occupancy contribution（TAX）
information_points.content:
CTED-TAX-AFG：For the Old Calton Assembly Halls proposal, visitor accommodation tax projections across designated conference hotel room blocks establish an average nightly accommodation levy yield of 4 GBP/bed.
CTED-TAX-GYF：For the Royal Meadow Pavilion proposal, visitor accommodation tax projections across designated conference hotel room blocks establish an average nightly accommodation levy yield of 6 GBP/bed.
CTED-TAX-BNL：For the Leith Docks Innovation Hub proposal, visitor accommodation tax projections across designated conference hotel room blocks establish an average nightly accommodation levy yield of 8 GBP/bed.

information_points.title: Tracks metropolitan economic spillovers, local retail spending models, and hospitality levies（ECON）
information_points.content:
CTED-ECON-UPG：For the Old Calton Assembly Halls proposal, econometric modeling of retail, hospitality, and cultural admissions within the metropolitan perimeter indicates a projected regional visitor spend of 810 kGBP in total incremental direct delegate spending outside the venue grounds.
CTED-ECON-Z0C：For the Leith Docks Innovation Hub proposal, econometric modeling of retail, hospitality, and cultural admissions within the metropolitan perimeter indicates a projected regional visitor spend of 620 kGBP in total incremental direct delegate spending outside the venue grounds.
CTED-ECON-MPB：For the Royal Meadow Pavilion proposal, econometric modeling of retail, hospitality, and cultural admissions within the metropolitan perimeter indicates a projected regional visitor spend of 620 kGBP in total incremental direct delegate spending outside the venue grounds.
